about: The rulesets and private vulnerability reporting of Thornswood and of the engine fork, EvilPatrick06/skymp (#3683, #3691). A change is a pull request to this file; once it merges, the Desk runs pwsh scripts/deploy/Set-BuildRunners.ps1 -RepoSettings (-Check first), which starts github-admin.yml in the private ops repository, and the box's admin service (scripts/vps/admin/admin.js, repo-settings) makes GitHub match it: each ruleset named here is made or put back by name, one GitHub has that this does not name stops the run and is never deleted, and reporting is switched as each entry says. A why is this file's own note and is never sent to GitHub.

repositories.why: No private_vulnerability_reporting here yet: GitHub offers it only on a public repository, so it is switched on in this file at the flip (#3721), when SECURITY.md's Security tab route opens too.

rulesets.name: release tags
rulesets.why: Patrick's A on q-3721-release-tags, 26 Oct 2026: only the admin role and GitHub Actions (15368, release-tag.yml) may make, move or delete a v* tag, since a tag names what a release was built from.

rulesets.name: main
rulesets.why: Patrick's A on q-3721-main-protection, 26 Oct 2026: admins included, no force push or deletion, and the build check required: the one always-run Build check result job (q-3683-required-check A), since a skipped Launcher builds counts as passing. Disabled until #3684's history rewrite has had its force push and that job is on main.

rulesets.name: thornswood/engine-changes: pull request, green build, no force push or deletion
rulesets.why: Patrick's A on q-3556-fork-protection, 26 Oct 2026 (#3556, #3691): the two jobs a pull request runs in thornswood-pr-windows.yml are required. No bypass: the lanes push under Patrick's own account.

rulesets.name: main: pull request, no force push or deletion
